_comment: FULL GAME RUN v2 -- adds a MODAL SWEEP to the turn cycle. v1 (full_game.json) carries only the RESEARCH closer, which is the one modal PROVEN to block (ai_stall_40turns v1 froze on it turns 20-35). Past turn 40 two more modal classes become reachable and would present the same way -- a run that executes every step against a frozen game: BattleViewWindow (first real combat) and ModalWindow (an engine modal message). Both closers are CANDIDATES measured from LDL only (battleview.ldl:149, messagebox.ldl:313/379), not yet observed blocking. They are safe to issue unconditionally because injection is idempotent-by-absence: with the window absent the hook finds no control and does nothing. NOT swept: MessageBoxDialog Left/RightButton -- that is a CHOICE, and pressing a choice blind mutates game state. Run with --save none --wait-display N.

(600,6) is empty chrome in the top menu bar, between the Options menu and the gold readout -- nothing is hit-tested there, so this delivers a mouse message without activating a control. This is the ONLY posted click in the file; every UI action below is injection or a key.
PREDICTION: scrolling the view damages the whole viewport and forces terrain to paint. If these frames are still black the thesis is wrong and the repaint trigger is something else.

Found the city, then QUEUE Spearmen: UnitsList index 0 (measured in pass 1 -- Spearmen/Minotaur/Peasants at 8/12/14 turns, so unit costs are sane too). Add > appends it to the build queue; no Rush Buy, because gold is 106 and a rush-buy confirm is a modal that would freeze captures.

TURN CYCLE x200 with modal sweep. Order matters: clear modals FIRST, then ping inert chrome at (600,6) -- the mouse message is what makes the injected enter count (ctp2-endturn-needs-mouse-input) -- then enter.
